subject: How do I know I've best set up shinyapps.io for multiple users?

messages.author: 55a7681d351c052b
messages.subject: How do I know I've best set up shinyapps.io for multiple users?
parts:
I want to publish a shiny doc that 50 - 100 people will access at once.
Is there a way to know if this will actually work or not?
I am currently using the Free plan.

(fyi: after initially publishing it to check that it works, it looks like the doc has a memory usage of 15mb).

I've read through most of the Scaling and Performance Tuning document, but I'm still not sure how I know my app will actually work.
Because this will be for an active workshop (i.e., a spike of 50 - 100 people at the same time), I'm hoping to get this all figured out before the workshop starts.

My questions:
1. How do I know my app will work for x # of people without actually explicitly testing it with 100 people?
2. How do I best fine tune my app (if at all)?
 - Again, I want 50-100 people to be able to interact with the shiny doc at the same time. 

I'm sorry if this is a simple/stupid question: I'm brand new to this and am just trying to figure all of this out!

-Chris
